Name: shore.1
Rich: Wind pushes the grass flat along the cliff path.
Text: Wind pushes the grass flat along the cliff path.

Name: shore.sign
Text: GULL POINT LIGHT Keeper on duty

Name: shore.3
Rich: You came up in this weather? Brave, or lost.
Speaker: keeper
Text: You came up in this weather? Brave, or lost.

Name: shore.5
Rich: Why is the lamp dark tonight?
Speaker: visitor
Text: Why is the lamp dark tonight?

Name: shore.wick
Rich: The <em>wick</> is spent. I was waiting for someone to fetch oil.
Speaker: keeper
Text: The wick is spent. I was waiting for someone to fetch oil.

Name: stores.1
Rich: Oil is in the shed. Mind the <b>third</> step.
Speaker: keeper
Text: Oil is in the shed. Mind the third step.

Name: stores.3
Rich: There. Now the boats can find the harbour.
Speaker: visitor
Text: There. Now the boats can find the harbour.

Name: leave.1
Rich: The path back is longer than you remember.
Text: The path back is longer than you remember.
